Anime Vault uses PyAV 16.1.0 (BSD 3-Clause) and dynamically linked
FFmpeg 8.0.1 libraries (GNU Lesser General Public License v3 or later)
from the PyAV Windows x64 wheel.

PyAV source and wheel build configuration:
https://github.com/PyAV-Org/PyAV/tree/v16.1.0
https://github.com/PyAV-Org/pyav-ffmpeg

FFmpeg source is available with the Anime Vault 1.2.1 release:
https://github.com/Agent47c/Anime-Vault/releases/tag/v1.2.1
Upstream source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.0.1.tar.xz
License: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html
